'''R4-D6''' was an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]], which was primarily [[Color/Legends|colored]] navy [[blue]], belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at its base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in the year [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:R4-D6_background.png|thumb|left|[[R4-D6]] in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] hangar.]]
This astromech can be seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']] in the Rebel Base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It can be seen in the background of the scene where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] confronts [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] shortly before the attack on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. It is behind Luke on the left hand side. It is the same prop as [[R4-I9/Legends|R4-I9]] and sometimes is mistaken for it.

R4-D6 has now been immortalized in the new ''Star Wars'' Legacy Collection "Build a Droid" toy line. On the reverse of certain Legacy figure cards you can find the component parts to build a total of four different Astromech droids, of which R4-D6 is one. The figures that contain these component parts are Han Solo Tatooine Sand Storm (left leg), Luke Skywalker Tatooine Sand Storm (right leg), [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] (head and middle leg), and [[Leektar/Legends|Leektar]] and [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] twin pack (main body).
